count_notes.creatures: 32 fauna families (ids 7-48, Kitin with 8 subtypes, Mektoub with 2 forms counted once each) plus 6 flora families (ids 68-73). Goo twin slots (74-115, 135-140) not counted as families.
count_notes.classes: 4 playable peoples plus 2 cults (Kami, Karavan). The 225-skill tree is not counted here.
count_notes.weapons: 10 melee item types, 6 ranged, 6 ammunition. Shields and bucklers not counted.
count_notes.gear_sets: 3 armour weights (light, medium, heavy), 5 slots each plus heavy helmet; clothes category named in help text only.
count_notes.zones: 22 named continent and area entries before UNKNOWN (continent.h). No biome or dungeon data in the box.

creature_families: Fauna families: 32 (ids 7-48), Kitin with 8 subtypes, Mektoub with packer and mount forms, Kami listed under fauna (people_pd.h)
Goo twin slot for every fauna family (ids 74-115) and flora family (ids 135-140), fixed offset +67 (people_pd.h, people_pd.cpp)
Classification types: 19 (people_pd.h TClassificationType, from line 263), including land and flying kitin, bird, fish, pachyderm, shellfish, kami
Idle and combat modes: normal, combat, alert, eat, rest, hungry, sit, swim, mount, death; 2 attack slots; 150 emote slots (common/src/game_share/mode_and_behaviour.h)
Boss pattern: outpost boss designed in war states but spawn body empty and marked not implemented (ai_service/family_profile_tribe.cpp lines 139-141, 241-243)

top_creatures.label: Insect swarm family with walkers and flyers
top_creatures.why: One family with 8 subtypes and a land and flying split; readable at 375 wide if flyers have a clear silhouette.
top_creatures.keep: One family with sub-forms; walker versus flyer as a class.
top_creatures.change: Our silhouettes, wing shapes and swarm counts.
top_creatures.ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/ryzom-ryzomcore/ryzom/common/src/game_share/people_pd.h lines 88-97, 275; invasion variant as zone data: fauna_zone_properties/activity_food_kitin_invasion.zone (0 bytes, not read)

top_creatures.label: Corrupted twin of every species
top_creatures.why: A goo variant exists for every fauna and flora family, so the roster doubles from one rule.
top_creatures.keep: One corrupted twin per species, driven by data.
top_creatures.change: A per-zone rule instead of a fixed id offset; our own colour and silhouette.

top_creatures.label: Pack beast with separate mount and packer forms
top_creatures.why: One species, two role forms: a load carrier and a rideable form.
top_creatures.change: Our forms, saddle and load art; our names.
top_creatures.ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/ryzom-ryzomcore/ryzom/common/src/game_share/people_pd.h lines 100-102 (ids only; look not in box)

top_creatures.label: Plant predator set
top_creatures.why: Six stationary flora families whose names suggest attackers; stationary threats read well from a fixed camera. Behaviour not read.
top_creatures.keep: A plant family as a stationary threat with its own silhouette.
top_creatures.change: Our behaviour and art; no copied plant attack.

top_creatures.label: Herd tied to zone food and rest
top_creatures.why: A herd exists only while its food and rest zone activities exist; losing the food activity despawns the herd.
top_creatures.keep: Herd presence depends on zone resources.
top_creatures.change: Our zone data fields and herd rules.

top_creatures.label: Timed invasion waves by family
top_creatures.why: Each main family has an invasion activity variant (frahar, gibbai, goo, kitin, cute); a wave is a zone data swap.
top_creatures.keep: A wave is a zone data swap with a start and an end.
top_creatures.change: Our wave timing, roster and messages.

top_creatures.label: Outpost boss that appears in war states (designed, not built)
top_creatures.why: Four outpost states decide whether fight groups and a boss are present; the state table is good, the boss spawn is empty.
top_creatures.keep: State-driven boss presence in a contested outpost.
top_creatures.change: Build the boss spawn this donor left empty.

top_creatures.label: Spire guard wanderer (low confidence)
top_creatures.why: A kami-tied wander activity sits near a kami spire animation. Only the name is known.
top_creatures.keep: A faction-tinted wanderer near a faction landmark.

classes: Fyros, Matis, Tryker, Zorai (playable peoples): race and home land; signature mechanic not in box; progression via skill tree (people_pd.h lines 56-59)
Kami and Karavan (cults): PvP faction; faction relation in PvP zones; faction points (pvp_clan.h lines 38-39)
Skill tree: 225 skills, root codes SC, SF, SH, SM, letter-coded branches with E and M suffixes; names not in box (skills.h line 27; skills.cpp line 272 stub)
Death penalty: XP debt after death, repaid over wall-clock time; minimum skill 10 (death_penalties.cpp lines 44-112; egs_variables.cpp line 57)
Spell bricks: one root verb plus modifier bricks; 8 roots, 27 key modifiers, 18 suffix bricks (client/data/gamedev/bricks_client.txt; AU)

Melee item types: dagger, sword, mace, axe, spear, staff, two-hand sword, two-hand axe, pike, two-hand mace (item_type.h lines 36-45)

Tier as quality: recommended skill; damage table by quality and skill, below quality blend, above quality decaying extension (server/src/entities_game_service/weapon_damage_table.cpp lines 69, 79; egs_variables.cpp lines 87-90)

gear_tiers: Light, medium, heavy armour sets: 5 slots each (boots, gloves, pants, sleeves, vest) plus heavy helmet (item_type.h lines 60-75)

Jewellery: anklet, bracelet, diadem, earring, pendant, ring (item_type.h lines 76-81)
Protection split by damage type: slashing, piercing, blunt; 7 elemental types after (common/src/game_share/damage_types.h lines 30-40)
Durability: items lose hit points with use and are destroyed at 0 (interf_info_item_armor_en.html)
zones: Home lands: FYROS, ZORAI, TRYKER, MATIS (common/src/game_share/continent.h line 28 onward)
Other regions: BAGNE, NEXUS, ROUTE_GOUFFRE, SOURCES, TERRE
Newbie areas: one per home land plus NEWBIELAND (5)
Other: CORRUPTED_MOOR, KITINIERE (insect-named region), INDOORS, TESTROOM
Seasons gate families: spring, summer, autumn, winter (season.h lines 55-58)
PvP versus zones between two clans with faction points; PvP safe zones (server/src/entities_game_service/pvp_manager/pvp_zone.cpp outline; pvp_safe_zone.cpp not read)
Hazards: goo path distance setting (egs_variables.cpp line 499); angry kami punishment while foraging (line 139); ecosystem resistance penalty (line 275)

originals.name: Tainted Twin
originals.idea: Any species in a tainted zone can spawn as a corrupted twin with its own silhouette.
originals.keep: A twin per species, set as zone data.
originals.change: A per-zone rule instead of a fixed id offset; our colour and shape.

originals.name: Swarm Flyers
originals.idea: One insect family with walkers and flyers, plus a zone-level invasion wave swap.
originals.keep: Sub-forms in one family; walker versus flyer; wave as data.
originals.change: Our silhouettes, counts and wave timing.

originals.name: Hardening Brute
originals.idea: A brute gains resistance to each crowd-control effect that hits it during a fight, and resets when the last attacker leaves.
originals.keep: Resist builds per hit; reset on disengage (creature.cpp lines 1926, 2036).
originals.change: Add a cap (the donor add has none); our numbers and effect names.

originals.name: Herd Budget
originals.idea: Grazers spawn to an energy target per zone with a hysteresis band; a herd leaves when its food or rest activity leaves the zone.
originals.keep: Energy target, hysteresis, zone activity check (family_behavior.cpp lines 455-476, 521-532).
originals.change: Fix the reversed check at family_behavior.cpp line 413; our data fields and rates.

originals.name: Pack or Mount Beast
originals.idea: One species with carrier and ride forms chosen by role.
originals.change: Our forms, saddle and load art.

originals.name: Outpost Warband
originals.idea: Contested outposts gain a boss in war states and lose it at peace.
originals.keep: State table with boss presence (family_profile_tribe.cpp lines 159-170).
originals.change: Build the boss spawn (empty in the donor).

originals.name: Crystal Charge
originals.idea: A consumable enchant writes a glow and a charge readout onto a weapon and wipes the previous enchant.
originals.keep: Consumable, charge readout, wipe rule (interf_info_item_misc_en.html lines 18-21).
originals.change: Our glow colour and consumable name.

originals.name: Glow-Read Node
originals.idea: A resource node whose glow colour gives the danger read before the player touches it.
originals.keep: Glow colour as the risk read (how_to_extractrawmaterialsfromasource_en.html line 32).
